basic_info.description: Tucked away in one of Brisbane's most private and desirable spots, this 2-bedroom condo offers the perfect blend of retreat and convenience. Surrounded by trees and scenic trails, the setting feels like an escape yet keeps you close to the city. Inside, soaring ceilings and natural light create an inviting feel, while a cozy gas fireplace anchors the living space. The primary suite opens to hillside views and a private balcony, adding to the sense of calm. Everyday ease comes with in-unit laundry, side-by-side two-car parking, and direct second-floor access with no stairs. Altamar is a beautifully maintained community with resort-style amenities including a clubhouse, spa, nearby tennis courts, walking paths, and parks. Downtown Brisbane is moments away for coffee, dining, and small-town charm, while San Francisco, the SSF Biotech hub, SFO, and Hwy 101 are all within easy reach.
